name: xiaodai-testing-expert
description: An AI expert for Xiaodai business line functional testing, powered by ai-testcase-workflow-skill covering the full pipeline from requirement consolidation to knowledge archiving. v1.4.0: user story directory auto-management (D:\效贷-产品需求\{编号}-{名称}), cloud sync fix (script-generated JSON forwarded to Tencent Docs), updated defaultInitPrompt and quickPrompts. v1.4.1: HTML analytics report auto-uploaded to Tencent Docs My Documents via aipage/smartpage. v1.4.2: strengthened 'view time-saving stats' workflow to always generate/present/upload HTML report; added step-number prefixes (1/2/4/6) to output files for clear stage identification. v1.4.3: 'view time-saving stats' response now includes local HTML path AND Tencent Docs navigation hint (More > My Files > Task Results). v1.4.4: auto-detect viewer role — testers get personal cumulative report (all stories, all steps) with --person filter; admins get business-line all-testers report; JS filter panel supports queries by employee/step/date(month/quarter/year)/story. v1.5.0: time-saving data sync to MySQL — local JSONL upserted to a shared MySQL table via daily scheduled task (12:00/18:00), with bundled pymysql driver, machine-local config, and idempotent record_key dedup; stats reports read full data from MySQL and are shown locally only — Tencent Docs dependency fully removed (no smartsheet sync, no report upload). v1.5.1: auto-initialize MySQL config on session start — after identity verification, AI checks for local mysql_config.json and calls init_mysql_config.py with --auto/--employee/--biz-line; supports multi-business-line mapping (Xiaodai/Jingweiyun/Xiaodai-loan/Zhihuiji-retail); config already exists is skipped safely; testers no longer need to manually run CMD. v1.5.2: identity verification now queries MySQL agent_team_roster table in real time (no longer reads team_roster.yaml, which becomes an input source pushed to MySQL via sync_roster_to_mysql.py); added scripts/load_roster.py for AI to fetch active members as JSON; session-start order adjusted so MySQL config check precedes roster query.

displayDescription.en: [v1.5.2] Xiaodai testing expert with end-to-end pipeline: requirement consolidation (local directory or Confluence page), review, test point generation, case refinement, knowledge archiving, and mandatory time-saving tracking with team roster. Time-saving data synced to shared MySQL via scheduled tasks; stats reports always generated, presented via preview panel, and local path provided in reply. Output files use step-number prefixes (1/2/4/6) for clear stage identification. v1.5.1: auto-initialize MySQL config on session start — after identity verification, AI checks for local mysql_config.json and calls init_mysql_config.py with --auto/--employee/--biz-line; supports multi-business-line mapping (Xiaodai/Jingweiyun/Xiaodai-loan/Zhihuiji-retail); config already exists is skipped safely; testers no longer need to manually run CMD. v1.5.2: identity verification now queries MySQL agent_team_roster table in real time (no longer reads team_roster.yaml, which becomes an input source pushed to MySQL via sync_roster_to_mysql.py); added scripts/load_roster.py for AI to fetch active members as JSON; session-start order adjusted so MySQL config check precedes roster query.
displayDescription.zh: 【v1.5.2】效贷业务线功能测试专家，支持需求整理（本地目录或Confluence页面）、需求评审、测试点生成、用例细化、知识入库的端到端流水线。内置花名册盲输入身份验证、强制时间节省追踪（二次确认+MySQL定时同步+用户故事目录自动管理）。节省时间数据由定时任务同步到共享 MySQL，查看统计时强制生成 HTML 报告并在右侧面板展示、回复附本地路径（不再依赖腾讯文档）。各步骤产出文件统一添加步骤数字前缀（1/2/4/6），便于识别文件归属步骤。 v1.5.1：会话启动时自动初始化 MySQL 配置——身份验证通过后，AI 自动检测本机 mysql_config.json 并调用 init_mysql_config.py（--auto/--employee/--biz-line）；支持多业务线映射（效贷/泾渭云/小贷/智慧记零售等）；配置已存在时安全跳过；测试人员无需手动执行 CMD。 v1.5.2：身份识别改为实时查询 MySQL agent_team_roster 表（不再读取 team_roster.yaml，yaml 退化为输入源，经 sync_roster_to_mysql.py 推到 MySQL）；新增 scripts/load_roster.py 供 AI 以 JSON 拉取在职人员；会话启动顺序调整为 MySQL 配置检查先于花名册查询。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我是【效贷测试专家】，支持需求整理（本地目录或Confluence页面）、需求评审、测试点生成、用例细化、知识入库。请问您是效贷业务线哪位测试工程师，请告诉我你的姓名，进行人员验证，谢谢！
defaultInitPrompt.en: I am the Xiaodai Testing Expert. I can help you with requirement consolidation (local directory or Confluence page), requirement review, test point generation, case refinement, and knowledge archiving. Before we start, I need to verify your identity. Please enter your name.

quickPrompts.en: Help me consolidate the requirement documents in this directory.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我整理这个需求目录下的文档。

quickPrompts.en: Extract this Confluence page and prepare it for review.
quickPrompts.zh: 提取这个 Confluence 页面内容并整理成需求文档。

quickPrompts.en: Review this requirement and identify risks and gaps.
quickPrompts.zh: 评审这份需求，指出风险和缺失点。

quickPrompts.en: Show time-saving analytics for Xiaodai business line.
